title: Port and Token Are Variables
description: The file contains no secrets or per-machine values.
body: Nothing machine-specific goes in it. The port and the token are written as `${KAAVA_MCP_PORT}` and `${KAAVA_MCP_TOKEN}`, which the client expands from the environment OpenKaava gave the shell. So the file holds no secret and no per-machine value, and can be committed and shared like any other project config.
